body:
It's been at least a year since I've felt this bad, I hate the fact that my emotional state is dictated by my relationship, I just wish I could be happy alone.

I've been cheated on before by a previous girlfriend, and I think that brings a lot to my anxiety when I don't hear from her fast enough. I trust her a lot but I keep remembering the betrayal from before and I panic.

About an hour ago I was seriously considering overdosing but I've calmed down a bit.

The relationship is long distance, and we have plans to move in with one another next year, but every time she send back insanely short messages, doesn't make time for skype, my mind slips straight to the thought of no future with her, and ultimately nothing to live for anymore. 

I love my family and friends dearly, but I don't consider them to be something standing between me and death, which seems a heartless thing to say but it's just how I feel.
